Weighted maturity score (0-100) combining Reach (30%), Habit (40%), and Skill (30%). Tracks overall progress towards Frontier Firm status.
Frontier Firm pattern classification: P1 Foundation (AI assists individuals), P2 Expansion (humans orchestrate, agents execute), P3 Frontier (agents handle whole workflows).
Reach dimension (0-100): 60% weighted on licence activation rate + 40% on usage concentration outside top 3 orgs. Measures breadth of AI deployment.
Habit dimension (0-100): Licensed habitual rate (40%), agent habitual rate (30%), licensed MoM retention (30%). Measures depth of routine use.
Skill dimension (0-100): App surface breadth (35%), agent adoption rate (35%), deep interactions rate (30%). Measures proficiency and delegation maturity.
Average number of distinct M365 app surfaces (Teams, Word, Outlook, etc.) used per active user. Target: 4+. Low = users stuck in one app.
Average number of distinct agents used per agent user. Higher = users exploring the agent ecosystem, not just one agent.
Percentage of conversation threads with 5+ prompts. Measures engagement depth vs. shallow single-prompt use. Target: >15%.
Average number of prompts per conversation thread. Higher = more substantive interactions. Benchmark: 2-3 is typical.
Percentage of total activity occurring outside the top 3 organisations. Higher = more even distribution. Target: >80%.
Percentage of organisations where users engage with both Copilot chat AND agents. Measures cross-product adoption at org level.
Percentage of licensed users active in both current and previous month. Measures month-over-month user retention. Target: >90%.
Percentage of agent users with 6+ active days in the last complete month. Measures habitual agent use. Target: >20% for P3.
Percentage of licensed users with 11+ active days last month. Measures habitual Copilot use. Target: >30% for P2 gate.
Average sessions per user per agent. Measures agent stickiness — higher = users returning to the same agent repeatedly.
HERO REACH: Percentage of all active users with meaningful AI use (>=5 sessions in any week across M365 Copilot, Agents, or Copilot Chat). Denominator = all active users.
HERO HABIT: Percentage of users active in >=9 of the past 12 rolling weeks. A user counts as active in a week if they have >=5 sessions. Measures sustained routine use.
HERO SKILL: Percentage of sessions classified as complex. Complex = >=2 of: multi-turn (>=3 prompts), agent/tool invoked. Proxy for prompt sophistication and delegation maturity.
